# MahjongKit

> Independent, beginner-friendly guides to American Mahjong, free practice games, and resources for people who teach it. Not affiliated with the National Mah Jongg League.

## Learn

- [Learn American Mahjong in 4 Lessons](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/course/): Free course; lessons on tiles and flow, the Charleston, calling and Jokers, and winning and scoring.
- [How to Play American Mahjong](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/how-to-play-american-mahjong/): The whole game in plain English.
- [American Mahjong Tiles Explained](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/american-mahjong-tiles/): All 152 tiles, grouped and illustrated.
- [What You Need to Start](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/what-you-need/): Set, card and table; what to check and what to skip.
- [Beginner Strategy](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/beginner-strategy/): Six principles for your first games.
- [The Charleston](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/charleston/): Passing order, blind pass, courtesy pass and strategy.
- [Defense and the Endgame](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/defense/): When to play defensively and safer discards.
- [Find a Game](https://mahjongkit.com/learn/find-a-game/): Where American Mahjong games happen locally.

## Practice

- [Solo Practice Hand](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/practice-hand/): Single-player practice hand with an original practice card and real Joker rules.
- [Tile Trainer](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/tile-trainer/): Practice games: tiles, Dragon pairings, numbers and suits.
- [Free Printables](https://mahjongkit.com/printables/): Table companion, Charleston card, scoring card, dead hands card, etiquette sheet, lesson plan.
- [Practice Workbook](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/workbook/): Paid printable drills with answer key.
- [Mahjong Solitaire](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/mahjong-solitaire/): Free matching puzzle with mahjong tiles; every deal solvable.
- [Flower Match](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/flower-match/): A relaxing Mahjong-inspired pattern game.
- [Play Online](https://mahjongkit.com/practice/play-online/): Where to play real American Mahjong online.

## Teach

- [Teach American Mahjong](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/): Hub for teachers: free course plan, printables to share, pricing and venues.
- [How to Teach Mahjong Lessons](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/mahjong-lessons/): Four-week course plan, pricing, venues and starting a club.
- [Teach a Beginner](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/teach-a-beginner/): Teaching one friend their first game.
- [Host a Game Night](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/host-a-game-night/): Setting up a friendly game night.

- [How Much to Charge for Mahjong Lessons](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/how-much-to-charge/)
- [How to Start a Mahjong Club](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/start-a-mahjong-club/)
- [Where to Teach Mahjong](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/where-to-teach/)
- [Private Mahjong Lessons](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/private-mahjong-lessons/)
- [Do You Need a Mahjong Teacher Certification?](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/mahjong-teacher-certification/)
- [Teacher’s Kit](https://mahjongkit.com/teach/teachers-kit/): Paid four-week course kit with the Practice Workbook.

## Rules

- [Payout Calculator](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/payout-calculator/): Who pays what after a win.
- [How to Read the NMJL Card](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/how-to-read-nmjl-card/): Colors, letters, groups, X and C.
- [Joker Rules](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/joker-rules/): Where Jokers can be used and exchanges.
- [Dead Hands](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/dead-hand/): What kills a hand and how challenges work.
- [Scoring and Payouts](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/mahjong-scoring-payouts/): Who pays what.
- [Mahjong Etiquette](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/mahjong-etiquette/): Table manners and the misnamed-discard rule.
- [Table Setup](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/table-setup/): Building and breaking the wall.
- [Glossary](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/glossary/): Mahjong terms.
- [Chinese vs. American Mahjong](https://mahjongkit.com/rules/chinese-vs-american-mahjong/): Key differences.
